description: Public profile of a stakeholder (customer, partner, …): named with approval, otherwise anonymous.

fields.description: A customer, partner (or later another kind of stakeholder) of phamos. One doctype, one website section per type: /de/kunden, /de/partner.
fields.label: Stakeholder

fields.description: Mirrored from the Customer; set by hand for other parties.
fields.label: Industry

fields.description: Anonymous pages show no name, logo, website or their people, use a neutral URL, and may not name the stakeholder in their texts. Named pages need the recorded approval.
fields.label: Naming

fields.description: Anonymous is always allowed. Named needs the stakeholder's approval below. Switching a named page to Anonymous retires its named URL (410).
fields.label: Publish As

fields.description: The stakeholder agreed to be named on the website (keep the written approval).
fields.label: Approved to Be Named

fields.description: Their contact shown in the page sidebar (a Person Web Profile of this party). Hidden on anonymous pages.
fields.label: Key Contact

fields.description: The phamos person responsible, shown next to the key contact.
fields.label: Account Manager (phamos)

fields.description: URL slug, generated from the title if empty. Same slug in both languages.
fields.label: Route

fields.description: URL slug while Publish As is Anonymous, e.g. 'mittelstaendischer-maschinenbauer'. Generated once from the German text title, else industry and region; never contains the stakeholder's name. Route above is the named URL.
fields.label: Anonymous Route

fields.description: One row per website language (Deutsch, English, …). A language without a row shows the German text, otherwise any other row. Title: only for anonymous pages, the neutral public title in this language, e.g. 'Mittelständischer Maschinenbauer' (empty: '<Industry> company, <Region>'). Summary: one answer-first sentence shown on tiles and at the top of the page. Content: the main text of the page.
fields.label: Website Texts
